mapper.insert: INSERT INTO health_resource_favorite (user_id, resource_type, resource_id, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{resourceType}, #{resourceId}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE updated_at = VALUES(updated_at)
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM health_resource_favorite WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND resource_type = #{resourceType} AND resource_id = #{resourceId}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM health_resource_favorite WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND resource_type = #{resourceType} AND resource_id = #{resourceId}
